annotations.title: Match a candidate to a job

description: Score one candidate against a job: returns a score between 0 and 1, a summary and an explained evaluation of each criterion (written in French). Use the criteria from extract_job_criteria and the resume text from parse_resume (info_resume.text). Costs 1 HireLayer credit.

matching_criteria.description: Criteria to evaluate, usually from extract_job_criteria.

id.description: Criterion ID, e.g. crit_1 from extract_job_criteria.

is_mandatory.description: Whether the job states it as a hard requirement.

label.description: What is evaluated, in a short phrase.

rationale.description: Why the criterion matters for the job.

name: match_candidate
title: Match a candidate to a job
